items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: No, I never did play with him, but I heard him a couple of times.

ctx.x: Well their pet keys and the tune might go for an hour.

Well the tunes that they were playing went that long. Every other chorus it would be another key and there used to be a trumpet player, used to hang everybody around him, and that was Benny Carter's cousin, boy named Cuba.
